reason: User requested entrenchment, homeland defence and forest/jungle defence instead of additional supply consumption in the defensive China programmes.

COLDWAR_VIE_china_survey.description: Survey defensive positions and prepare local fieldworks. Better knowledge of the ground helps existing formations entrench; it does not construct free forts.
COLDWAR_VIE_china_survey.conditions: China exists. Entrenchment bonuses apply to Vietnamese troops on every front.

COLDWAR_VIE_china_liaison.description: Coordinate local reserves, field engineers and defensive positions. Prepare to defend Vietnamese core territory rather than sustaining a costly offensive mobilisation.
COLDWAR_VIE_china_liaison.conditions: Survey the Defences. Replaces Frontier Readiness. Entrenchment applies on every front; homeland defence applies on Vietnamese core territory.

COLDWAR_VIE_china_hold.description: Hold prepared positions, disperse infantry under forest cover and use familiar jungle approaches. Stronger entrenchment and homeland defence come at the expense of offensive planning.
COLDWAR_VIE_china_hold.conditions: Exclusive defensive plan during an actual war with China. Entrenchment applies on every front; homeland defence applies on Vietnamese core territory. Forest and jungle defence applies to Vietnamese army units fighting in those terrain types against any opponent while this posture is active.

COLDWAR_VIE_china_depth.description: Organise successive defensive positions, concealed reserves and fallback lines through wooded and jungle terrain. This deepens the defence of the homeland while reducing the emphasis on offensive planning.
COLDWAR_VIE_china_depth.conditions: Hold the Line during an actual war with China. Replaces Northern Defence. Entrenchment applies on every front; homeland defence applies on Vietnamese core territory. Forest and jungle defence applies against any opponent while this posture is active.

renewal_cost_risk: The selected programme replaces its own policy family. Defensive fieldworks add no supply consumption penalty. Entrenchment applies across fronts, homeland defence on Vietnamese cores and terrain training in forests and jungle. Offensive alternatives retain their own costs.
